review_stage: Final independent recheck of economics v1.1
overall: Central expected-value accounting reconciles and supports a positive conditional service model. Commercial performance and demand remain unmeasured. Identified issues concern scenario completeness, pricing-plan enforceability, reference labels and late-collection robustness; they do not independently invalidate the central arithmetic.

verified_baseline.same_scope: Human 4/8/16-hour estimates include triage, repair, independent verification, notebook/CLI construction, environment/hashes/diff/documentation, expected correction/support and handoff. Hours remain estimated, not human trials.
verified_baseline.accounting_once: Expected outcome costs include successful, corrected, rejected and refunded jobs. Fees apply to initial payments including later refunds. Acquisition contains sales labor and channel expense once. No duplicate research/Gym/learning bill found.
verified_baseline.acceptance_and_demand: 85% retained acceptance, 20% inquiry conversion, 40 inquiries/month and USD25 qualified-lead cost are explicitly unobserved assumptions. Four technical examples cannot calibrate them.
verified_baseline.automated_workflow: No mandatory manual quality-review gate is costed. Human support and exception hours are proposed expected allowances, not measured usage.
verified_baseline.cash: Default seven-day collection delay precedes warranty close; all initial customer receipts are fully reserved. Reserve releases are not expenses. Default expected cash closes to full project return; deterministic first-cohort refund stress is included.
verified_baseline.capacities: Selected deterministic scenarios are below modeled human and agent capacity. Neither throughput nor two-business-day SLA is measured.

findings.finding: Aggregate token envelopes do not by themselves establish eligibility for short-context prices.
findings.required_resolution: Provide an explicit feasible multi-call allocation or enforceable cap <=272,000 input tokens and <=128,000 output per request, counting repeated context and reasoning. Label the plan counterfactual, not measured execution.
findings.independent_stress: If all aggregate tokens instead incur long-context rates, central full project return falls from USD36309.008 to USD32435.408; positivity survives this isolated sensitivity.
findings.resolution_status: Addressed in v1.1 through code, additional scenario or explicit assumption/evidence boundary; underlying unmeasured quantities remain unmeasured.

findings.finding: The initial no_buyers case has zero inquiries, so it omits failed paid acquisition. Setting purchase_conversion to zero raised ZeroDivisionError in the reviewed code.
findings.required_resolution: Add a fixed 40-inquiry/month zero-conversion campaign and handle zero purchases without dividing by conversion. It should retain USD12000 annual acquisition, USD10800 fixed operations and USD4000 setup, giving USD−26800 full project return.
findings.resolution_status: Addressed in v1.1 through code, additional scenario or explicit assumption/evidence boundary; underlying unmeasured quantities remain unmeasured.

findings.finding: Central 85% service acceptance has no empirical customer calibration. Current notebook-modernization prior art reports 40.1%/44.9% mechanical recovery on a different, broader corpus.
findings.required_resolution: Include those as evidence-informed stress points while explicitly denying that mechanical recovery is a matched estimate of retained customer acceptance.
findings.resolution_status: Addressed in v1.1 through code, additional scenario or explicit assumption/evidence boundary; underlying unmeasured quantities remain unmeasured.

findings.finding: ParaTools USD249/hour is unloaded; its source also gives USD412.97 loaded. Calling 16×249 a complete human outlay is imprecise despite the existing caveat.
findings.required_resolution: Use USD412.97/h for the high loaded reference (USD6607.52 for 16h), or explicitly label USD3984 an unloaded resource lower bound and keep it out of exact customer-outlay claims.
findings.resolution_status: Addressed in v1.1 through code, additional scenario or explicit assumption/evidence boundary; underlying unmeasured quantities remain unmeasured.

findings.finding: When collection_delay_days exceeds the 14-day warranty, the initial cash function refunds/releases a reserve before collection and fails its nonnegative-reserve assertion. Reproduced with collection_delay_days=35.
findings.required_resolution: Separate warranty determination from settlement. Refund/release only funds actually received; after warranty, collect only retained accepted balances or otherwise maintain a consistent late-receipt event order. Include a late-collection cash sensitivity.
findings.resolution_status: Addressed in v1.1 through code, additional scenario or explicit assumption/evidence boundary; underlying unmeasured quantities remain unmeasured.

findings.finding: The model implicitly collects every accepted invoice and has no chargeback, bad-debt or late dispute assumption.
findings.required_resolution: State 100% eventual collections and zero uncompensated chargebacks as conditional assumptions, or add noncollection/dispute sensitivity. Do not present modeled accepted revenue as assured cash.
findings.resolution_status: Addressed in v1.1 through code, additional scenario or explicit assumption/evidence boundary; underlying unmeasured quantities remain unmeasured.

findings.finding: The cash ledger treats the USD95/hour opportunity-cost proxy as cash-paid labor.
findings.required_resolution: State that the financing scenarios assume fractional labor is actually paid at this modeled rate. If owner time is imputed instead, separate noncash owner opportunity cost from cash funding.
findings.resolution_status: Addressed in v1.1 through code, additional scenario or explicit assumption/evidence boundary; underlying unmeasured quantities remain unmeasured.

findings.finding: Five calendar days in the cash model differs from the two-business-day proposed offer.
findings.required_resolution: Label five days a conservative cash-timing buffer; do not assert measured service-level compliance.
findings.resolution_status: Addressed in v1.1 through code, additional scenario or explicit assumption/evidence boundary; underlying unmeasured quantities remain unmeasured.

findings.finding: The actual artifacts restore archived textbook code, and a free newer edition exists. These do not establish an underserved paying market for those exact examples.
findings.required_resolution: Preserve this prominently beside the commercial headline. Model paid delivery only for customer-specific orphan analyses without an equivalent substitute. This limitation does not automatically veto a transparent conditional service model.
findings.resolution_status: Addressed in v1.1 through code, additional scenario or explicit assumption/evidence boundary; underlying unmeasured quantities remain unmeasured.

final_review.result: PASS for conditional accounting, scenario completeness and scoped cash arithmetic; no validation of demand or real commercial operation
remaining_evidence_limits: Customer demand, acceptance probabilities and token consumption unmeasured
Paid target population differs from educational technical proxies with free replacements
Human hours, service timing and future operational capacity are estimates
Collection-loss sensitivities are expense challenges, not complete stochastic collection models
